atoms.name: Instruction fields
atoms.one_line: An instruction is opcode + mode bits + operands; field widths add up to the word size.

atoms.name: Address formats
atoms.one_line: Zero (stack), one (accumulator), two, three address; load-store keeps arithmetic on registers.

atoms.name: Addressing modes
atoms.one_line: Immediate, direct, indirect, register, register indirect, indexed, base, PC-relative, auto-inc/dec.

atoms.name: Effective address and memory accesses
atoms.one_line: EA is where the operand lives; indirect adds one read per level; register operands cost none.

atoms.name: Bits for fields
atoms.one_line: ceil(log2 N) bits for N registers, opcodes or modes; immediate gets the leftover; max unsigned = 2^k − 1.

atoms.name: Expanding opcodes
atoms.one_line: Unused short prefixes are extended: free codes × 2^(extra bits), subtracted level by level.

atoms.name: PC, instruction size and branches
atoms.one_line: PC steps by instruction length; PC-relative offsets start at the next instruction; byte alignment rounds up.

atoms.name: Endianness
atoms.one_line: Little endian stores the least significant byte at the lowest address; big endian the reverse.

atoms.name: ISA vs microarchitecture, RISC vs CISC
atoms.one_line: ISA is what programs see; RISC is load-store, fixed length, hardwired; CISC has many modes and microcode.

atoms.name: Tracing instruction sequences
atoms.one_line: Track the counter and pointer per loop trip; count trips before looking at memory.

patterns.name: Program tracing, memory accesses, return address
